Each case study starts from one narrow question that public data can answer well. Below are the
questions we may take up next. **Vote for the ones you would like us to answer**, or suggest a new
one. Votes help us choose between questions of similar quality; they do not decide on their own
whether a question is feasible.

## Our open questions

```{=html}
<table class="table rq-table" id="rq-ours">
  <thead><tr><th>Question</th><th>Region</th><th class="rq-num">Votes</th><th></th></tr></thead>
  <tbody></tbody>
</table>
```

## Reader questions

Questions sent by readers appear here once we have checked that public data could answer them,
in our own wording. Each stays listed for up to 90 days.

```{=html}
<table class="table rq-table" id="rq-readers">
  <thead><tr><th>Question</th><th>Region</th><th class="rq-num">Votes</th><th></th></tr></thead>
  <tbody></tbody>
</table>
<p id="rq-readers-empty" class="rq-help" hidden>No reader questions listed at the moment.</p>
```

## Suggest a question

We take short, specific questions on agri-food, water, climate and rural policy, for example
*"Do El Niño years cut rice output in Southeast Asia more than an average bad year?"* We read
every question; those that public data can answer well are listed above and may become one of
our next case studies, tagged *Reader questions*.

**We don't reply individually, and we don't collect contact details.** To see every new case
study, including any answer to your question, follow
<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/mithril-metrics">Mithril Metrics on LinkedIn</a> and turn on notifications, or
subscribe to our <a href="index.xml">RSS feed</a>.

```{=html}
<form id="rq-form" class="rq-form" novalidate>
  <label for="rq-text" class="form-label">Your question</label>
  <textarea id="rq-text" class="form-control" rows="3" maxlength="300"
    placeholder="One question, one sentence if possible"></textarea>
  <div class="rq-help"><span id="rq-count">0</span>/300 characters · no links</div>
  <label for="rq-region" class="form-label mt-2">Region (optional)</label>
  <select id="rq-region" class="form-select">
    <option value="">Any or several</option>
    <option>EU</option><option>Sub-Saharan Africa</option><option>South Asia</option>
    <option>Southeast Asia</option><option>Latin America</option><option>Global</option>
  </select>
  <div class="rq-hp" aria-hidden="true">
    <label for="rq-website">Leave this empty</label>
    <input id="rq-website" type="text" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
  </div>
  <div id="rq-captcha-submit" class="rq-captcha"></div>
  <div class="form-check rq-consent">
    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="rq-consent" required>
    <label class="form-check-label" for="rq-consent">I agree that Mithril Metrics may edit,
    shorten or reword my question, use it for an analysis, and publish it, in its own wording,
    on this site and its channels (such as LinkedIn) together with any answer. My question
    contains no names, personal or confidential information.</label>
  </div>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" id="rq-send" disabled>Send question</button>
  <div id="rq-msg" class="rq-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
</form>
<div id="rq-captcha-vote" class="rq-captcha-vote"></div>
```

<p class="rq-privacy">We store only the question text, the region and vote counts; no names or
emails. To limit spam, Cloudflare checks each request, and we keep codes derived from your network
address that cannot be turned back into it, for at most 30 days. Details in our
<a href="privacy.html">privacy policy</a>.</p>

```{=html}
<style>
.rq-preview-banner { background:#fff4d6; border:1px solid #e8c868; border-radius:6px;
  padding:.6rem .9rem; margin-bottom:1.2rem; font-size:.95rem; }
.rq-table td, .rq-table th { vertical-align: middle; }
.rq-table .rq-num { text-align:right; width:4.5rem; }
.rq-table td.rq-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rq-region { white-space: nowrap; color:#5b6876; font-size:.92rem; }
.rq-vote { white-space: nowrap; width:6rem; text-align:right; }
.rq-vote button { font-size:.85rem; padding:.15rem .6rem; }
.rq-tag { display:inline-block; font-size:.75rem; color:#5b6876; border:1px solid #cfd6dd;
  border-radius:3px; padding:0 .3rem; margin-left:.35rem; }
.rq-form { max-width: 560px; }
.rq-help { font-size:.85rem; color:#5b6876; margin-top:.2rem; }
.rq-hp { position:absolute; left:-10000px; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; }
.rq-captcha { margin:.8rem 0; min-height:1rem; }
.rq-consent { font-size:.88rem; color:#3d4a56; margin:.8rem 0; }
.rq-msg { margin-top:.6rem; font-size:.95rem; }
.rq-closed { padding-left:1.1rem; }
.rq-closed .rq-reason { color:#5b6876; }
.rq-privacy { font-size:.85rem; color:#5b6876; margin-top:2rem; }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  // GO-LIVE: fill in both values. While api is empty the page runs in preview mode.
  var CONFIG = {
    api: "https://reader-questions.mithrilmetrics.workers.dev",
    sitekey: "0x4AAAAAAGQkNKE7zDFgzGsf"   // Turnstile site key (public)
  };
  var LIVE = CONFIG.api !== "" && CONFIG.sitekey !== "";

  var sampleReaders = [
    { id: "R-EX1", title: "Do farms in drought-prone regions of Brazil use more irrigation per tonne of soy?", region: "Latin America", votes: 0, days_listed: 76, list_days: 90 },
    { id: "R-EX2", title: "Has the gap between rice farm-gate and retail prices in the Philippines widened since 2020?", region: "Southeast Asia", votes: 0, days_listed: 12, list_days: 90 }
  ];
  var sampleClosed = [
    { title: "Do El Niño years bring unusually severe rice shortfalls in Southeast Asia?", note: "Answered", link: "cases/2026-11-elnino-rice-tails/report.html" },
    { title: "Example: How would world agriculture look without any farm subsidies?", note: "Not picked within 90 days", link: null }
  ];

  var ours = [];
  var readers = [];
  var votes = {};
  var voted = {};
  try { voted = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("rq-voted") || "{}"); } catch (e) { voted = {}; }

  var msg = document.getElementById("rq-msg");

  // ---- Turnstile (live only) ----
  var widgets = {};
  var pending = {};
  function turnstileReady() {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var tries = 0;
      (function wait() {
        if (window.turnstile) return resolve(window.turnstile);
        if (++tries > 100) return reject(new Error("captcha"));
        setTimeout(wait, 100);
      })();
    });
  }
  function getToken(action) {
    return turnstileReady().then(function (ts) {
      return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        pending[action] = { resolve: resolve, reject: reject };
        if (!widgets[action]) {
          widgets[action] = ts.render(action === "submit" ? "#rq-captcha-submit" : "#rq-captcha-vote", {
            sitekey: CONFIG.sitekey, action: action, execution: "execute", appearance: "interaction-only",
            callback: function (t) { var p = pending[action]; pending[action] = null; if (p) p.resolve(t); },
            "error-callback": function () { var p = pending[action]; pending[action] = null; if (p) p.reject(new Error("captcha")); }
          });
        } else {
          ts.reset(widgets[action]);
        }
        ts.execute(widgets[action]);
      });
    });
  }
  function post(path, body) {
    return fetch(CONFIG.api + path, {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body)
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (j) { return { status: r.status, body: j }; }); });
  }

  // ---- rendering (all values inserted as text) ----
  function cell(tr, text, cls) {
    var td = document.createElement("td");
    td.textContent = text;
    if (cls) td.className = cls;
    tr.appendChild(td);
    return td;
  }
  function render(tableId, rows, isReader) {
    var tbody = document.querySelector("#" + tableId + " tbody");
    tbody.replaceChildren();
    rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return (votes[b.id] || 0) - (votes[a.id] || 0); })
      .forEach(function (r) {
        var tr = document.createElement("tr");
        var td = cell(tr, r.title);
        if (isReader) {
          var tag = document.createElement("span");
          tag.className = "rq-tag";
          tag.textContent = "listed " + r.days_listed + " of " + r.list_days + " days";
          td.appendChild(tag);
        }
        cell(tr, r.region || "–", "rq-region");
        cell(tr, String(votes[r.id] || 0), "rq-num");
        var vtd = cell(tr, "", "rq-vote");
        var b = document.createElement("button");
        b.type = "button";
        b.className = "btn btn-outline-primary";
        b.textContent = voted[r.id] ? "Voted" : "▲ Vote";
        b.disabled = !!voted[r.id];
        b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Vote for: " + r.title);
        b.addEventListener("click", function () { castVote(r.id, b); });
        vtd.appendChild(b);
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });
    if (isReader) document.getElementById("rq-readers-empty").hidden = rows.length > 0;
  }
  function renderAll() {
    render("rq-ours", ours, false);
    render("rq-readers", readers, true);
  }
  function renderClosed(list) {
    var ul = document.getElementById("rq-closed");
    ul.replaceChildren();
    list.forEach(function (c) {
      var li = document.createElement("li");
      li.appendChild(document.createTextNode(c.title + " "));
      var s = document.createElement("span");
      s.className = "rq-reason";
      s.textContent = "(" + c.note + ")";
      li.appendChild(s);
      if (c.link) {
        li.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" "));
        var a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = c.link;
        a.textContent = "Read it";
        li.appendChild(a);
      }
      ul.appendChild(li);
    });
    if (!list.length) {
      var li = document.createElement("li");
      li.textContent = "Nothing closed in the last 30 days.";
      ul.appendChild(li);
    }
  }
  function markVoted(id) {
    voted[id] = true;
    try { localStorage.setItem("rq-voted", JSON.stringify(voted)); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function castVote(id, button) {
    if (!LIVE) {
      votes[id] = (votes[id] || 0) + 1;
      voted[id] = true;
      renderAll();
      return;
    }
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = "…";
    getToken("vote").then(function (token) { return post("/api/vote", { id: id, token: token }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (res.status === 200) {
          if (res.body.counted) votes[id] = (votes[id] || 0) + 1;
          markVoted(id);
        } else if (res.status === 429) {
          msg.textContent = "Vote limit for today reached. Thank you for taking part.";
        }
        renderAll();
      })
      .catch(function () { renderAll(); });
  }

  // ---- submission ----
  var text = document.getElementById("rq-text");
  var count = document.getElementById("rq-count");
  text.addEventListener("input", function () { count.textContent = text.value.length; });
  var consent = document.getElementById("rq-consent");
  var sendBtn = document.getElementById("rq-send");
  consent.addEventListener("change", function () { sendBtn.disabled = !consent.checked; });
  document.getElementById("rq-form").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var v = text.value.trim();
    if (!consent.checked) { msg.textContent = "Please tick the consent box to send your question."; return; }
    if (v.length < 20) { msg.textContent = "Please write a full question (at least 20 characters)."; return; }
    if (/https?:|www\.|<|>/i.test(v)) { msg.textContent = "Please leave out links and angle brackets."; return; }
    var done = "Thank you. We check every question; if public data can answer it, it appears under Reader questions within about two weeks, in our wording.";
    if (!LIVE) { msg.textContent = done + " (Preview: nothing was sent.)"; text.value = ""; count.textContent = "0"; consent.checked = false; sendBtn.disabled = true; return; }
    var send = document.getElementById("rq-send");
    send.disabled = true;
    msg.textContent = "Sending…";
    getToken("submit").then(function (token) {
      return post("/api/submit", {
        text: v, region: document.getElementById("rq-region").value,
        website: document.getElementById("rq-website").value, token: token
      });
    }).then(function (res) {
      if (res.status === 200) { msg.textContent = done; text.value = ""; count.textContent = "0"; consent.checked = false; }
      else if (res.body.error === "bad_text") { msg.textContent = "Please check the question: 20–300 characters, no links."; }
      else if (res.status === 429) { msg.textContent = "Thank you, that is the limit of questions for today."; }
      else { msg.textContent = "Sorry, the question could not be sent. Please try again later."; }
    }).catch(function () {
      msg.textContent = "Sorry, the spam check failed. Please reload the page and try again.";
    }).then(function () { send.disabled = !consent.checked; });
  });

  // ---- load data ----
  fetch("data/open_questions.json").then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
    ours = d.questions || [];
    if (!LIVE) {
      readers = sampleReaders;
      renderAll();
      renderClosed(sampleClosed);
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById("rq-banner").hidden = true;
    return fetch(CONFIG.api + "/api/public").then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (p) {
      votes = p.votes || {};
      readers = p.readers || [];
      renderAll();
      renderClosed(p.closed || []);
    });
  }).catch(function () {
    renderAll();
    msg.textContent = "The question list could not be loaded. Please try again later.";
  });
})();
</script>
```
